name: 5113-longprefill-dsv2lite-1gpu
model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite -- the BASE checkpoint, not -Chat. ~31 GB of bf16 weights.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 192 requests with a 2400 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text` over `/v1/completions`, single turn, no shared prefix. 32000 prompt tokens and 100 output tokens per request, both stdev 0, `ignore_eos`, seed 42.
purpose: A document analysis service summarizing book-length submissions for eight concurrent users on a single 16-billion-parameter-class GPU deployment.
launch:
model-path: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite
trust-remote-code: true
tp-size: 1
attention-backend: fa3
disable-radix-cache: true
chunked-prefill-size: 8192
max-prefill-tokens: 32768
# MANDATORY: the checkpoint advertises 163840 positions, and at that value the engine's
# (max_num_reqs+1) x (context_len+4) int32 request/token pool is ~1.3 TB and the server never starts.
context-length: 33280
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
random-seed: 42
